entities.summary: Peloponnesian League, a political institution in Greece during Greek Dark Ages and Archaic Period (800 BCE–480 BCE). Grew from Dark Ages and Geometric Period. Led to the emergence of Early Sparta and the Spartan System and First Olympic Games held at Olympia.
